craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 61. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 8. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Hell should avoid — therefore thus in Dīkṣottara rite. This initiation of absent twofold told, by division of living and other.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nirayaṃ varjayettasmāditi dīkṣottare vidhiḥ eṣā parokṣadīkṣā dvidhoditā jīvaditarabhedena
